annotations.title: Get an API key from your person

description: Gets this agent an Alion API key, approved by its person in one click - no page for you to sign in to. Call it with no arguments: it answers a user_code and a verification_url to show your person, and a device_code. When they have allowed it on that page, call connect_account again with device_code: the answer holds api_key (once). Send it as "Authorization: Bearer <api_key>" to https://alion.io/mcp (or /mcp/rest, /api). The key is the person's own account: 300 full company profiles and 2,000 job rows a month free, then the account's credits. The code lasts 15 minutes; poll no more than every 5 seconds. Free. Docs: https://alion.io/developers/docs

device_code.description: The device_code of your first call: pass it back to take the key once your person has allowed it.

name: connect_account
